synopsis: Hae-Jin and Ki-Hyeok met at the same taekwondo dojo when they were children. They used to be quite close, but as their respective paths in life took shape, their relationship became distant and awkward, almost as if they were strangers. In fact, ever since their days at the taekwondo dojo, Hae-Jin has always looked up to Ki-Hyeok, and finally, at the start of their freshman year of high school, the two reunite in the same school and the same class. However, Ki-Hyuk appears in such a disheveled state that he shatters Hae-Jin’s expectations. Despite this, Hae-Jin’s feelings for Ki-Hyeok refused to fade; instead, his obsession and determination kicked in, and he resolved to restore the object of her admiration to his former glory with her own hands. And so, Hae-Jin’s inexplicable obsession with Ki-Hyeok— his grand transformation project—began. (Source: KakaoPage, translated) Note: The first story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

Muscleman
Muscule Man
Musculman
KINNIKUMAN (M.U.S.C.L.E.)
synopsis: Kinnikuman (a.k.a. Kinniku Suguru) is a cowardly, clumsy, moronic, gyuudon-devouring excuse for a superhero (or Choujin)... who just happens to be the prince of an alien planet. But despite his pathetic appearance, he is very honorable and can become quite powerful when he needs to be. With his sidekick Meat-kun and fellow Choujins Terryman and Ramenman there to help him, Suguru quests to become the greatest Choujin on the planet. Whether with a combination of tremendous heart and stamina (The Burning Inner Strength) or the "Power of Friendship", Kinnikuman frequently defeats villians 10 times more powerful than him and often causes his enemies to have a change of heart and join him. Though he seems destined to be an idiot forever, slowly but surely Kinnikuman becomes worthy of the title "Hero". Notes: - Between volumes 36 and 37 publication there's 22 years gap. From volume 38 onwards starts restarted in 2011 version. - Kinnikuman won the 30th Shogakukan Manga Award for best children's manga in 1984.

title: Miboujin Elf no Kanamori-san
titleNative: 未亡人エルフの金森さん
synonyms: Kanamori-san, The Widowed Elf
synopsis: When a boy consoles Kanamori-san, a beautiful elf whose husband has passed away, by saying "I'll marry you myself," she takes him in as her fiancée...? A sweet and precious pure love comedy between a clumsy delinquent boy and the slightly naive Kanamori-san, with an age gap 500 years apart. (Source: Monthly Action, translated) Note: Originally a one-shot published in Monthly KiSSCA 2020 Oct. issue, with a sequel in December. It was picked up for full serialization in Comic Action starting 2023-02-25.

title: What If I Said, "I Love You"?
titleRomaji: Ore ga Suki tte Ittara Dou suru?
titleEnglish: What If I Said, "I Love You"?
titleNative: 俺が好きって言ったらどうする？
synopsis: Kazuho and Tokio have been best friends since elementary school. As the years went on, Kazuho realized his feelings for Tokio were more than just friends, and he began pulling away from Tokio, desperate to keep his feelings a secret. While once close enough to give each other piggyback rides, the two boys, now high school students, pass each other in the hallway as the distance grows between them. But when Kazuho can’t keep his feelings hidden from Tokio any longer, will the two friends only continue to drift apart, or will it be the start to them experiencing the feelings of first love together? (Source: Kodansha USA)
